status: four-panel structurally-evaluable subset frozen after matched x-y-time preflight and before vertical output
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism test; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims or rescue failed five-panel generalization

preflight.exclusion_reason: only 1/12 kinematic-state evaluable individuals retained >=50 common fine-place×state endpoints at 2 km

ecological_hypotheses.route_patch_allocation: Residual vertical individuality is largely generated by individuals repeatedly using different 2-km horizontal routes/patches within broad kinematic states.
ecological_hypotheses.within_fine_context: Individual centered vertical organization remains non-exchangeable even after self and other profiles are evaluated under identical 2-km fine-place × speed×turn-state distributions.

estimator.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session median from all retained numeric-height events before selecting valid kinematic endpoints
estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 2-km fine cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.common_weighting: equal-session self distribution over jointly supported fine-cell×state strata, applied identically to self and other vertical profiles
estimator.target_scoring: target kinematic endpoints whose 2-km cell×state stratum is supported by both predictors

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived kinematic states
calibration.preserve: within-session fine-place-state-residual-z observations and exact session-count multiset per label
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated common fine-place-state identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Within the four structurally evaluable panels, 2-km route/patch allocation is insufficient as a general explanation; individuality persists within fine-place × kinematic contexts.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Mixed mechanism: fine-place allocation may explain much of the pattern in some systems, while within-context individuality remains in others.
decision_matrix.0_pass: Consistent with 2-km fine-place allocation accounting for most residual individuality in the structurally evaluable subset, subject to support/power.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon; no five-panel generalization; no claim about sub-2-km exact routes/resources.

claim_boundary: Subset membership and expected n were fixed by x-y-time-only preflight before this vertical outcome.
A PASS indicates persistence within 2-km matching strata, not exact route/resource identity.
Fine cells are matching strata, not verified feeding patches.
Persistence does not prove morphology, memory, learning or intrinsic personality.
This family cannot replace the failed five-panel fine-place test and remains outside v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change subset, 2-km grid, speed2_turn2 state definition, centering, bins, 50-event support, expected n, permutation B/seeds or pass criteria after vertical output.
If any observed evaluable n differs from preflight expected n, stop and invalidate rather than retune.
